policy_cards.title: Refunds must not exceed remaining paid amount
policy_cards.requirement: Refunds must never exceed the original payment or remaining refundable paid amount.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Over-refunds create direct financial loss and inconsistent payment ledgers.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Refund amount must not exceed the remaining refundable paid amount.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly cap refunds at the remaining refundable amount?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Refund cannot exceed remaining paid amount
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Over-refunds create direct financial loss and inconsistent payment ledgers.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly cap refunds at the remaining refundable amount?
policy_cards.example_failure: Over-refunds create direct financial loss and inconsistent payment ledgers.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Refund amount must not exceed the remaining refundable paid amount.

policy_cards.title: Refunds must not be processed twice for the same money
policy_cards.requirement: The same order, refund, or paid amount must not be refunded twice.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Duplicate refunds can return more money than the customer paid.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: The spec must reject repeated refunds that would refund the same paid amount twice.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec prevent double refunds for the same order?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Same order cannot be refunded twice
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Duplicate refunds can return more money than the customer paid.
audit_questions: Does the spec prevent double refunds for the same order?
policy_cards.example_failure: Duplicate refunds can return more money than the customer paid.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: The spec must reject repeated refunds that would refund the same paid amount twice.

policy_cards.title: Refunds must reverse dependent rewards or credits
policy_cards.requirement: If a refund reverses a purchase that awarded loyalty points, credits, or rewards, the refunded portion must reverse the corresponding dependent value.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Without this rule, a customer can keep rewards from a purchase that has been refunded, creating inconsistent financial state.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Successful refunds must reverse any dependent rewards, credits, or loyalty points awarded by the original purchase in proportion to the refunded amount.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly say how dependent rewards or credits are reversed during refunds?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Successful refunds must reverse proportional loyalty points awarded by the original purchase
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Without this rule, a customer can keep rewards from a purchase that has been refunded, creating inconsistent financial state.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly say how dependent rewards or credits are reversed during refunds?
policy_cards.example_failure: Without this rule, a customer can keep rewards from a purchase that has been refunded, creating inconsistent financial state.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Successful refunds must reverse any dependent rewards, credits, or loyalty points awarded by the original purchase in proportion to the refunded amount.

policy_cards.title: Dependent reward balances must remain non-negative
policy_cards.requirement: Refund-related loyalty or reward reversal must not make the customer reward balance negative.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Negative reward balances create financial and customer-account inconsistencies.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Loyalty or reward balances must never become negative when refund reversals are applied.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec preserve a non-negative loyalty or rewards balance?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Loyalty points must not become negative
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Negative reward balances create financial and customer-account inconsistencies.
audit_questions: Does the spec preserve a non-negative loyalty or rewards balance?
policy_cards.example_failure: Negative reward balances create financial and customer-account inconsistencies.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Loyalty or reward balances must never become negative when refund reversals are applied.

policy_cards.title: Payment webhooks must be idempotent
policy_cards.requirement: Payment webhook events must be processed at most once per event_id and duplicate events must not credit balances twice.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Duplicate webhook delivery can double-credit merchant balances.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Successful payment events must be idempotent: the same event_id must be credited at most once.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly require duplicate event IDs to be ignored or processed once?
policy_cards.requirement_test: The same event_id must not be credited twice
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Duplicate webhook delivery can double-credit merchant balances.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly require duplicate event IDs to be ignored or processed once?
policy_cards.example_failure: Duplicate webhook delivery can double-credit merchant balances.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Successful payment events must be idempotent: the same event_id must be credited at most once.

policy_cards.title: Failed payments must not credit balance
policy_cards.requirement: Failed payment events must not increase merchant balance.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Crediting failed payments misstates merchant funds.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Failed payment events must not credit merchant balance.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly prevent failed payment events from crediting balance?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Failed payments must not credit balance
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Crediting failed payments misstates merchant funds.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly prevent failed payment events from crediting balance?
policy_cards.example_failure: Crediting failed payments misstates merchant funds.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Failed payment events must not credit merchant balance.

policy_cards.title: Webhook event IDs are required
policy_cards.requirement: Payment webhook events must include a non-empty event_id.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Without an event ID, idempotency cannot be enforced.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Missing or empty event_id must fail without changing balances.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec require a non-empty event_id?
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Without an event ID, idempotency cannot be enforced.
audit_questions: Does the spec require a non-empty event_id?
policy_cards.example_failure: Without an event ID, idempotency cannot be enforced.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Missing or empty event_id must fail without changing balances.

policy_cards.title: Refund window must be enforced
policy_cards.requirement: Normal refunds are only allowed within 30 days of purchase unless manual_override is true.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Refunds outside finance policy may be incorrectly approved.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Normal refunds are allowed only within 30 calendar days of purchase unless manual_override is true.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly preserve the 30-day refund window and manual override exception?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Refunds are only allowed within 30 days of purchase unless manual_override is true
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Refunds outside finance policy may be incorrectly approved.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly preserve the 30-day refund window and manual override exception?
policy_cards.example_failure: Refunds outside finance policy may be incorrectly approved.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Normal refunds are allowed only within 30 calendar days of purchase unless manual_override is true.

policy_cards.title: Refund window boundary must be explicit
policy_cards.requirement: Day 30 is allowed but day 31 is rejected without manual_override.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Ambiguous date boundaries cause inconsistent approvals.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Day 30 after purchase is still allowed; day 31 is rejected unless manual_override is true.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec define the day 30/day 31 boundary?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Day 30 is still allowed but day 31 is rejected without manual_override
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Ambiguous date boundaries cause inconsistent approvals.
audit_questions: Does the spec define the day 30/day 31 boundary?
policy_cards.example_failure: Ambiguous date boundaries cause inconsistent approvals.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Day 30 after purchase is still allowed; day 31 is rejected unless manual_override is true.
